_readme: Contact page copy and every string in the enquiry form, including its validation messages.

meta.title: Contact us
meta.description: Request a quotation from {company} in {city}, {region} — forklift and hand pallet truck repair, hydraulics, refrigeration, air-conditioning, motor rewinding and fabrication.

form.title: Send us the details
form.description: The more you can tell us — equipment, brand, fault and location — the more useful our first reply will be.

map.note: Add a Google Maps embed here once the exact pin is confirmed.

clientNote.label: Note for the client:
clientNote.body: Everything else on this page comes from your company profile and tarpaulin. All of it — contact details, hours and wording — lives in public/locale/en/.

message.label: Message
message.placeholder: Tell us the equipment and brand, what it is doing (or not doing), and where it is located.

errors.emailRequired: Enter your email address so we can reply.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, e.g. name@company.com.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, or leave this field empty.
errors.subjectRequired: Add a subject so we can route your message.
errors.messageRequired: Tell us what you need help with.
errors.messageShort: Please add a little more detail (at least {min} characters).
errors.messageLong: Please keep the message under {max} characters.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again or call us.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection, or contact us by phone or email.

success.title: Message sent
success.message: Salamat — your enquiry has been received. Our team will get back to you with a quotation or to arrange a check-up.

unconfigured.title: Message not sent
unconfigured.message: This website is not yet connected to a message delivery service, so your message was not sent.
